CardDescription.DefaultText:
Plants and mushrooms can grow here, provided they have the right level of acidity, nutrition and hydration.

Excessive fertilizing can lead to mites, and excessive hydration to fungus. Inspecting your gardens often can help your plants grow stronger.
CardDescription.Text: 植物和蘑菇可以在这里生长，只要它们具有适当的酸度、养分和湿度。\n\n过度施肥会导致螨虫病，湿度过高会导致真菌感染。经常检查你的花园，帮助你的植物长得更强壮。
CardDescription.zh: 植物和蘑菇可以在这里生长，只要它们具有适当的酸度、养分和湿度。\n\n过度施肥会导致螨虫病，湿度过高会导致真菌感染。经常检查你的花园，帮助你的植物长得更强壮。
CardDescription.en: Plants and mushrooms can grow here, provided they have the right level of acidity, nutrition and hydration.\n\nExcessive fertilizing can lead to mites, and excessive hydration to fungus. Inspecting your gardens often can help your plants grow stronger.
CardDescription.ja: 適切なレベルの酸度、栄養、水分があれば、植物やキノコはここで育つ。\n\n 肥料を使いすぎるとシロアリが発生する。水分を与えすぎると菌が生える。頻繁にガーデンを確認すれば植物を健康に育てられる。

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Basics: Add water to hydrate it and fertilizer to enrich it. Acidity: Add dry leaves to increase acidity or ash to lower it. Pests: Garlic Water can help treat fungus and firewater can help with mites.
CardHelpSection.Text: 基本知识：加水滋润土壤，施肥滋养土壤。 酸度：加干叶增加酸度，加灰降低酸度。 害虫：大蒜水可治真菌，火根水可治螨虫。
CardHelpSection.zh: 基本知识：加水滋润土壤，施肥滋养土壤。 酸度：加干叶增加酸度，加灰降低酸度。 害虫：大蒜水可治真菌，火根水可治螨虫。
CardHelpSection.en: Basics: Add water to hydrate it and fertilizer to enrich it. Acidity: Add dry leaves to increase acidity or ash to lower it. Pests: Garlic Water can help treat fungus and firewater can help with mites.
CardHelpSection.ja: 基本： 水を与えて水分を上げ、肥料を与えて栄養を上げる。 酸度： 乾燥した葉を与えたら、酸度が上がり、灰を与えたら酸度が下がる。 害獣： 菌類にはニンニク水、ダニにはファイヤーウォーターを使う。
